brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Build has 4 base pieces: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full. Counts {piece:4}. No bins/soil were added (see next requirement).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: One irrigation run installed run:run-1 at level 0 starting at -1,1 entryEdge 3 through [0,0, 1,0]. It physically routes through the bases of 3 cells (-1,1, 0,0, 1,0) and is visible in get_build. Cell 0,1 has no pipe. A single run covering all 4 cells was refused by the configurator: ROUTE_NO_PATH for 1,0->0,1 and ROUTE_CELL_OCCUPIED (one run per cell, bores meet at center) when trying to branch or to add a second run; tryInstead offered only the 3-cell route which was applied. No PVC-bore bins added.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell diamond base with a single level-0 irrigation run through 3 of the 4 bases. The configurator enforces one run per cell and only allows certain edge-to-edge paths, so a continuous pipe feeding all four cells in this topology is not possible ( refused with ROUTE_NO_PATH / ROUTE_CELL_OCCUPIED). The built run feeds cells -1,1, 0,0 and 1,0; cell 0,1 remains without pipe. No planter bins or soil were installed, so the bases alone form the planter structure.

lines.key: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 302 mm over 2 corners

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
